title: PAR-20/7G.3 DETAILVIEWSTYLE and SECTIONVIEWSTYLE NOD root alias refusal

finding.source: The typed/raw model-document style validator required one canonical NOD key, a complete NOD-owned child dictionary, and exact typed-style child coverage, but did not apply the shared root guard that rejects another NOD key targeting the same dictionary.
finding.coverageGap: Generated owner-family controls did not prove atomic refusal of both a case-folded duplicate canonical root and a differently named alias for DETAILVIEWSTYLE and SECTIONVIEWSTYLE.
finding.scope: Root uniqueness and alias refusal for the two model-document view-style NOD routes only; no broad semantic or consumer claim.

implementation: Applied validateNamedObjectRootForExport() inside the existing family-specific validateStyleDictionary() path for ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE and ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE.
Extended the existing generated model-document view-style callback selector to exercise duplicate canonical keys and same-target aliases for both roots in ASCII and Binary.

Each malformed graph must be refused with its seeded destination unchanged; corrected retry must succeed and strict readback must show a unique canonical root, one NOD-owned dictionary target, and no alias.
